body.description: Clean, highly readable in small UI parts

spacing_and_layout.padding: Generous. Use 16px to 24px padding for main containers.
spacing_and_layout.borderRadius: 16px to 24px for cards to feel premium and soft.
spacing_and_layout.borders: 1px solid rgba(212, 175, 55, 0.2) on surfaces to add depth without relying heavily on shadows.

buttons.primary: Background #D4AF37 (Gold), Text #0B081A. Rounded pill shapes (borderRadius 30). Font Outfit 600.

path_nodes.description: Duolingo-style vertical path. Use Star or Moon icons.
path_nodes.completed: Gold background, bright icon, connected by solid gold line.
path_nodes.current: Pulsing animation, larger scale, surrounded by gold aura.
path_nodes.locked: Muted indigo background #24184E, connected by dashed line.

cards.style: Surface #1A103C with Gold subtle border. Soft inner shadow if possible. Use golden aspect ratio for Tarot cards (approx 2:3).

bottom_tab_bar.style: Background #110A2E, borderTopWidth 1, borderTopColor rgba(212, 175, 55, 0.1). Active icon Gold, Inactive icon Lilac (#AFA5CA).

views.Auth: Simple, centered form. Elegant typography. Gold accent on inputs. Minimalist inputs with bottom borders or soft surface backgrounds.
views.Home: Vertical scroll path of nodes. Sticky top header showing XP, Level, Daily Streak (fire icon), and Hearts (heart icon) in gold/red.
views.Lesson: Bite-sized flashcards. Swipe left/right or tap to flip. Focus on single card meaning, upright/reversed switch.
views.Quiz: Multiple choice questions. Top progress bar filling up in gold. Immediate visual feedback (green/red borders) on selection.
views.Progress_Profile: Grid of stats. Display user's current 'Tarot Level' (e.g., The Fool, The Magician). Dark mysterious theme.

animations.interactions: Smooth tap scales (0.95 scale on press).
animations.rewards: Gold particles or soft glowing pulses when completing a lesson.

background_texture.description: Night sky with stars. Use with low opacity (10-20%) overlay on the main background to add depth.

tarot_placeholder_1.description: General tarot card aesthetic image for library or lesson placeholders.

mystical_book.description: Black and gold book, useful for progress or library header backgrounds.

accessibility_and_testing.test_id_convention: All interactive elements MUST include a 'testID' attribute (since it's React Native, use testID instead of data-testid). Format: kebab-case, role-based. e.g., testID='login-button'.
accessibility_and_testing.contrast: Ensure text meets 4.5:1 ratio against the dark indigo background.

instructions_to_main_agent: Build this as an Expo React Native app using standard React Native components (View, Text, TouchableOpacity, ScrollView, etc.).
Use 'testID' on all interactable elements for testing.
Implement navigation using Expo Router or React Navigation.
Apply the font families (Playfair Display, Outfit) using expo-font.
Create a gamified node path UI on the Home screen inspired by Duolingo.
Maintain the deep dark theme with gold accents. Avoid pure black and pure white.
